title: Access AI Assistant from Self-Service Portal
story: As a requestor, I want to access the Agentforce AI Assistant directly from the self-service portal, so that I can receive assistance and raise tickets without navigating through forms.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am logged in and on the home page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Agentforce icon is displayed on the home page

acceptanceCriteria.given: the Agentforce icon is displayed on the home page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the AI Assistant panel opens and the assistant greets me and explains its capabilities

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am authenticated on the portal
acceptanceCriteria.when: I click the Agentforce icon and interact with the assistant
acceptanceCriteria.then: my identity is automatically recognized based on portal authentication
I receive a clear message and an alternative method for raising a ticket

edgeCases: Assistant loads on slow network connections
Multiple browser tabs with the portal open simultaneously
User not authenticated attempts to access assistant
